file_name: Sanad and Tikehau-Revima - Third party questionnaire.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Sanad Services or any business owned or managed by Tikehau Capital are close competitors to Revima and there are not many alternatives, or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Sanad Services, any business owned or managed by Tikehau Capital, or Revima.
